AND A.MINWON_DATE >= #{START_DATE}
AND A.MINWON_DATE <= #{END_DATE}
AND A.MINWON_GBN = #{MINWON_GBN}
AND ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(A.STATUS_CD)),'') = #{STATUS_CD}
AND A.GBN = #{GBN}
AND CONVERT(INT, A.DONG_ID) >= CONVERT(INT, #{ST_DONG})
AND CONVERT(INT, A.DONG_ID) <= CONVERT(INT, #{END_DONG})
AND CAST(SUBSTRING(A.HO_ID, CHARINDEX('-', A.HO_ID) + 1, LEN(A.HO_ID)) AS INT) >= CONVERT(INT, #{ST_HO})
AND CAST(SUBSTRING(A.HO_ID, CHARINDEX('-', A.HO_ID) + 1, LEN(A.HO_ID)) AS INT) <= CONVERT(INT, #{END_HO})
AND A.GBN != '0'
AND A.GBN = '1'
AND A.GBN NOT IN ('0','1')
AND (A.DESCR LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%' OR D.WORK_DESC LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%')
AND A.DESCR LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%'
AND D.WORK_DESC LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%'
ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.MINWON_DATE) DESC, CONVERT(INT, A.SLIP_NO) DESC
ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.MINWON_DATE), CONVERT(INT, A.SLIP_NO)

SELECT A.GBN AS GBN, A.DONG_ID AS DONG_ID, B.DONG_NAME AS DONG_NAME, A.HO_ID AS HO_ID, A.LINE_NO AS LINE_NO, A.LINE_GBN AS LINE_GBN, SUBSTRING(A.HO_ID, CHARINDEX('-', A.HO_ID) + 1, LEN(A.HO_ID)) AS HO, C.HOUSE_SIZE AS HOUSE_SIZE, C.HOUSEHOLDER AS HOUSEHOLDER, C.HP_NO AS HP_NO, C.FLOOR AS FLOOR, COUNT(A.SLIP_NO) AS TOTAL_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN A.STATUS_CD = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PROC_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN A.STATUS_CD = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HOLD_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN A.STATUS_CD = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REJECT_CNT, SUM(CASE WHEN A.STATUS_CD = '4' OR A.STATUS_CD = '' OR A.STATUS_CD IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PENDING_CNT FROM dbo.TMN_MINWON A LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_DONG B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.DONG_ID = B.DONG_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_DONG_HO C ON A.OFFICE_CODE = C.OFFICE_CODE AND A.DONG_ID = C.DONG_ID AND A.HO_ID = C.HO_ID WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.GBN = '0' AND (A.DEL_YN = '' OR ISNULL(A.DEL_YN,'N') != 'Y')

AND A.MINWON_DATE <= #{END_DATE}
AND CONVERT(INT, A.DONG_NAME) >= CONVERT(INT, #{ST_DONG})
AND CONVERT(INT, A.DONG_NAME) <= CONVERT(INT, #{END_DONG})
AND CAST(SUBSTRING(A.HO_ID, CHARINDEX('-', A.HO_ID) + 1, LEN(A.HO_ID)) AS INT) >= CONVERT(INT, #{ST_HO})
AND CAST(SUBSTRING(A.HO_ID, CHARINDEX('-', A.HO_ID) + 1, LEN(A.HO_ID)) AS INT) <= CONVERT(INT, #{END_HO})
GROUP BY A.GBN, A.DONG_ID, B.DONG_NAME, A.HO_ID, A.LINE_NO, A.LINE_GBN, C.HO, C.HOUSE_SIZE, C.HOUSEHOLDER, C.HP_NO, C.FLOOR ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.DONG_ID), CONVERT(INT, C.FLOOR), C.HO
